{{Youmay|the [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]] Telltrig-7 blaster|the [[canon]] [[Telltrig-X blaster]]}}
[[File:Hansoloprofile.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Han Solo owned a Telltrig-7 as a backup weapon in a rag.]]
The '''Telltrig-7 blaster''' was a [[Hold-out blaster/Legends|holdout blaster]], ideal for use in confined spaces. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] was known to hide a Telltrig-7 in a rag for use when he was repairing the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], and could not draw his [[DL-44 heavy blaster pistol/Legends|DL-44 heavy blaster pistol]] without drawing attention.
